description: Sistema microwave containers are great for cooking rice, couscous, polenta and more, as well as reheating meals and storing leftovers. The 2.6L Rice Cooker features a unique pressure chamber plate to ensure rice stays moist and fluffy, simply add rice and water, close the distinctive Sistema easy-locking clips and cook for perfect rice every time. This microwave rice cooker also comes with a non-stick rice spoon, eliminating the need for additional utensils. The Microwave Round container has been specifically designed for microwave cooking and reheating, and features a steam release vent in the lid for splatter-free reheating. Both containers have easy-lift tabs on the lids that make transporting from microwave to table simple, and both are top rack dishwasher-safe, fridge and freezer-safe, and microwave-safe with the vent open. Designed and made in New Zealand, these quality food containers are phthalate and BPA-free.
